title: Crop image to fill fixed thumbnail
goal: combines object-fit and object-position to keep thumbnails in proportion.
summary: The thumbnail of the exhibition hall with a fixed space needs to fill the viewfinder frame. A small part of the edge is allowed to be cropped, and the top of the image should be retained.
tasks: uses cover for .thumbnail to fill an existing 160×100px box.
Align content to the top and center it horizontally.

example.note: cover scales to cover the box. object-position specifies how to crop the portion beyond the box.

hint: dimensions have been written, keep them and add object-fit and object-position.
